messages.subject: About strating values in open N-mixture models
parts:
Hello everyone!

I'm trying to fit some open N-mixture models to monitoring data of Testudo hermanni using unmarked. I have data from 113 sites, with 2 primary periods, and 3 secondary period for each primary period. 
I'm using the pcountOpen function to create my models, and I've seen different examples using starting values for these types of models, but I don't really understand what they are, which parameter is assign to each value of the vector of starting values, and what values should be used.

Can anyone help me understand this issue? Or does anyone have any recommendations for documentation on this subject?

Thank you very much for your time in advance,
Regards,
Julie Quessada
